title: Inner product with a basis function
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index. For every complex-valued function $f$ on $Ω$ and every $i\in ι$, the probability-weighted inner product of $f$ with the $i$th basis function is the complex conjugate of the coefficient of $f$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
